description: Pure-Python risk engine: all 15 rule signals, language detection, email checks, URL check; real /scan endpoint replacing stub; training data files (60+ scam + 60+ legit samples, scam library); classifier training script, classifier module, score blending, LLM fallback stub; evaluation script; rules tests. FEAT-002 depends on FEAT-001 (directory structure, models, and scan schema must exist). backend/engine/ must have ZERO FastAPI imports.
steps: 1. Create data/scam_samples.json: array of 65+ objects {text, label:'scam'} covering all 5 categories. Distribution: ~15 fake_job_offer, ~15 phishing, ~12 romance_scam, ~12 advance_fee, ~11 impersonation. Include English and isiZulu examples (at least 10 isiZulu). Examples must be realistic: include URLs, phone numbers, urgency phrases, generic greetings, WhatsApp redirects, and upfront-fee asks. Use the demo sample messages from en.json as inspiration but expand significantly.

2. Create data/legit_samples.json: array of 65+ objects {text, label:'legit'} covering: bank OTPs ('Your ABSA OTP is 123456, valid for 5 minutes'), genuine delivery notifications, money-transfer confirmations from Mukuru/Western Union, ordinary chat messages, receipt confirmations, appointment reminders, loyalty programme updates. Must NOT trigger FAKE_JOB_OFFER, REQUESTS_OTP_PIN (as scam — OTP confirmations are legit), or ADVANCE_FEE.

3. Create data/scam_library.json: array of entries {id, category, example_message, red_flags:[], advice:[]}. 2-3 entries per category = 10-15 total. id format: '{category}_{001}'. red_flags and advice values must all exist in shared/reason_codes.json message_reason_codes and advice_codes respectively.

4. Create backend/engine/__init__.py (empty or minimal exports). Create backend/engine/language_detect.py: detect_language(text:str) -> str. Wraps langdetect.detect(), catches all exceptions and returns 'en'. Maps langdetect codes to supported codes: 'af'->None(fallback en), 'zu'->'zu', 'fr'->'fr', 'sw'->'sw', 'st'->'st', 'hi'->'hi', 'nl'->'nl', 'pt'->'pt', else fallback 'en'. No FastAPI imports.

5. Create backend/engine/url_check.py. Extract all URLs from text using regex (http/https/www). MOCK_BAD_DOMAINS list: at minimum 25 known malicious/scam domains (e.g. 'absa-secure-login.co', 'sars-refund-portal.net', 'fnb-verify.xyz', 'bit.ly', 'tinyurl.com', 't.co', 'wa.me'). SHORTENED_URL_DOMAINS = {'bit.ly','tinyurl.com','t.co','goo.gl','ow.ly','short.io','rb.gy'}. check_urls(text:str, mock:bool=True, api_key:str|None=None) -> UrlCheckResult(urls_found:list[str], any_malicious:bool, any_shortened:bool, source:str). When mock=True: compare extracted hostnames against MOCK_BAD_DOMAINS. When mock=False and api_key set: call Google Safe Browsing Lookup API v4 (POST https://safebrowsing.googleapis.com/v4/threatMatches:find) with URLs only — never send message text. Return source='mock' or 'safe_browsing'. LOOKALIKE_DOMAINS legitimate base list: ['absa.co.za','fnb.co.za','standardbank.co.za','nedbank.co.za','capitecbank.co.za','mukuru.com','westernunion.com','sars.gov.za','dhl.com','postnet.co.za']. Levenshtein distance check: if any extracted domain has edit distance <= 2 from any legitimate domain, flag as lookalike. No FastAPI imports.

6. Create backend/engine/email_checks.py. check_email(text:str, sender:str='', reply_to:str='', display_name:str='') -> list[Signal]. Signals produced: EMAIL_MISMATCH if sender domain != reply_to domain (both non-empty). DISPLAY_NAME_SPOOF if display_name contains a known brand name but sender domain doesn't match that brand. GENERIC_GREETING if text matches regex 'dear (customer|user|beneficiary|sir|madam|account holder)' case-insensitive. LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN if sender/reply_to domain has edit distance <= 2 from a legitimate domain. URGENCY_LANGUAGE via the same urgency keyword check as rules.py. Return list of Signal objects. No FastAPI imports.

7. Create backend/engine/rules.py. Define Signal = namedtuple('Signal', ['code', 'weight', 'matched']). Define RulesResult dataclass: score:int, reasons:list[str], advice:list[str], category:str. Load WEIGHTS and ADVICE_BY_CATEGORY from shared/reason_codes.json at import time using os.path relative to this file's __file__ (absolute path). Implement all 15 check functions:
- check_suspicious_link(text, urls): Signal — uses url_check result
- check_requests_otp_pin(text, lang): matches 'otp','pin','password','code','secret' + lang keywords
- check_urgency_language(text, lang): 'act now','expire','immediately','urgent','limited time','24 hours' + lang keywords
- check_impersonation(text, lang): bank/courier/govt name patterns + mismatch keywords
- check_move_to_whatsapp(text): 'whatsapp','wa.me','move chat','continue on wa'
- check_asks_for_money(text, lang): currency amounts (R\d+, $\d+, USD) + transfer verbs
- check_fake_job_offer(text, lang): 'hiring','salary','registration fee','work from home','wfh','work-from-home','job offer','earn per week'
- check_advance_fee(text, lang): 'release funds','processing fee','inheritance','unclaimed funds','transfer fee','prize'
- check_romance_scam(text, lang): 'love you','met online','send me','stuck in','darling','my dear' + money request
- check_lookalike_domain(text, urls): from url_check LOOKALIKE_DOMAINS list
- check_shortened_url(text, urls): from url_check SHORTENED_URL_DOMAINS
- check_phone_in_message(text): embedded phone pattern E.164 or local format
- check_generic_greeting(text): 'dear customer','dear user','dear beneficiary','dear account holder'
- check_email_mismatch(text, meta): from email_checks.py result
- check_display_name_spoof(text, meta): from email_checks.py result
Keyword lists include: English (full), isiZulu (full — coordinate with i18n/zu.json), French/Swahili/Sesotho/Hindi/Dutch/Portuguese (shorter lists). run_rules(text:str, channel:str='web', meta:dict={}) -> RulesResult: call all 15 checks, collect matched Signals, compute score=min(100, sum of weights for matched signals), select category from highest-weight matched signal's categories list, trim reasons to top 3 by weight, look up advice from ADVICE_BY_CATEGORY[category], enforce: if score>=70 and len(reasons)==0: set score=69 and tier=CAUTION. No FastAPI imports.

8. Create backend/engine/llm_fallback.py. LLMResult = dataclass(category:str, explanation:str). classify_with_llm(text:str, user_lang:str='en') -> LLMResult|None. If LLM_ENABLED env var is not 'true': return None immediately. Otherwise: construct a prompt asking the LLM to classify the text as one of the 5 categories and explain in one sentence in user_lang. Call OpenAI-compatible API (use LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_API_KEY, LLM_MODEL from env). On any exception: log warning and return None. No FastAPI imports.

9. Create scripts/train_classifier.py. Use absolute paths (os.path.dirname(__file__) based). Load data/scam_samples.json + data/legit_samples.json. Build texts list and labels list. Pipeline: TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1,2), sublinear_tf=True) + LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=1000, class_weight='balanced'). StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5) CV, print mean accuracy, precision, recall, f1. Fit final pipeline on full dataset. Save to backend/model/classifier.pkl using pickle (absolute path). Print 'Model saved to backend/model/classifier.pkl'.

10. Create backend/engine/classifier.py. CLASSIFIER_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'model', 'classifier.pkl'). Use functools.lru_cache to load the pipeline once. predict(text:str) -> float: load pipeline, call predict_proba([text])[0][1], return float 0.0-1.0. On FileNotFoundError or any exception: log warning 'classifier.pkl not found, returning 0.5', return 0.5. No FastAPI imports.

11. Replace backend/routers/scan.py stub with real implementation. POST /scan: parse ScanRequest. Hash text with SHA-256 (hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()). Detect language with detect_language(text). Run check_urls(text, mock=settings.MOCK_SAFE_BROWSING). Run run_rules(text, channel, meta={'urls':url_result, 'lang':detected_lang}). Call classifier.predict(text) -> classifier_score. blended = round(RULES_WEIGHT * rules_result.score + CLASSIFIER_WEIGHT * (classifier_score * 100)). Clamp 0-100. If 30 <= blended <= 60 and settings.LLM_ENABLED: try classify_with_llm(text, user_lang). Determine tier from blended score using thresholds. Enforce: tier==HIGH_RISK requires len(reasons)>=1; if not, reduce to CAUTION (score=69). Create and save ScanResult row (text_hash=sha256, never raw text). Return ScanResponse.

12. Create backend/tests/test_rules.py. Use pytest. Import run_rules from backend.engine.rules (no FastAPI). Tests: one positive + one negative for each of the 15 signal types (30 test cases). Additional tests: HIGH_RISK never returned without reasons; fake-job demo SMS -> tier HIGH_RISK, category fake_job_offer; bank OTP sample -> SAFE or CAUTION, FAKE_JOB_OFFER not in reasons; legit delivery notification -> not HIGH_RISK. Create scripts/evaluate_classifier.py: load classifier.pkl, load data/legit_samples.json, predict all, count FP (legit predicted as scam, i.e. predict_proba > 0.5), print precision/recall/FP_rate, sys.exit(1) if FP_rate > 0.10.
acceptance_criteria: backend/engine/ contains no FastAPI imports (grep -r 'fastapi' backend/engine/ returns nothing)
python scripts/train_classifier.py — completes and saves backend/model/classifier.pkl
python scripts/evaluate_classifier.py — FP rate <= 10%, exits with code 0
POST /scan with demo fake-job SMS returns tier=HIGH_RISK, category=fake_job_offer, 1-3 reasons all in shared/reason_codes.json
data/scam_samples.json has >= 60 entries, data/legit_samples.json has >= 60 entries, data/scam_library.json has 2-3 entries per category
